readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine at dinner, as the uncle asked everyone to take out their watches
When the temple struck nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine
When the temple struck ten, while Félix was in the library
When the temple struck ten, Félix's watch showed twenty to ten
Eighteen minutes past ten by Félix's watch, when he heard a thump on the floor above him in the atelier
The uncle's repeater sounded ten slow deep notes, which Félix counted (the repeater is not one of the listed timepieces)
A quarter past ten by Félix's watch, when someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
Twenty-one minutes past ten by Félix's watch, when someone came quickly down the stairs
Thirty-two minutes past ten by Félix's watch, when Bastien Girard came into the library
When the temple struck eleven, by which time Félix and Girard had been sitting together in the library

durations: An hour ("another hour gone", between the temple's strikes of nine and ten, as Félix put it)
whereabouts: At dinner, Félix was at the table with the others when the temple struck nine and the uncle asked everyone to take out their watches
The uncle was at the dinner and made a scene in front of everyone about Félix's watch
After dinner, Félix went up to the library
Félix stayed in the library alone for a time
Félix drank brandy in the library
Félix's aunt was playing the piano downstairs
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at a quarter past ten (identity not known to Félix)
Someone came quickly down the stairs at twenty-one minutes past ten; Félix did not see who, as the library door was shut
A thump was heard on the floor in the atelier, directly above the library
Bastien Girard came into the library at thirty-two minutes past ten and sat with Félix until the temple struck eleven
The library is directly under the atelier
